identity.name: MedicAI Design System
identity.philosophy: Clinical Glass - A fusion of sterile medical precision with the warmth of human care and the depth of modern tech.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix medical sterility with consumer app fluidity.
Emotion First: Trust and Calm are the primary emotions.
Content is King: Data visualization must be instant and actionable.
Zoom In: Focus on the patient data that matters right now.
Negative Space: Use white space to reduce cognitive load for stressed medical staff.

Card.base: bg-white border border-slate-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden

Button.primary: bg-sky-500 hover:bg-sky-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-sky-500/20 transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5
Button.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:border-slate-300

Input.base: bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 focus:bg-white focus:border-sky-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-sky-100 transition-all rounded-lg

universal_guidelines: Avoid generic 'Bootstrap' layouts. Use asymmetry and whitespace.
Do not use full-screen gradients. Use subtle mesh gradients or solid colors.
Ensure high contrast for all text (WCAG AA minimum).
All interactive elements must have hover and focus states.
Do not use 'transition: all'. Animate specific properties.
Use 'Manrope' for headings to give a modern, medical-tech feel.
Glassmorphism should be subtle (white/70), not heavy blur.
Shadows should be colored (e.g., shadow-sky-500/10) not just black.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-end medical dashboard. Use the provided colors and fonts. Implement the 'Clinical Glass' aesthetic by using the glass utility classes defined in the colors section for sticky headers and overlays. Keep the main content area clean and high-contrast. Use the provided image URLs for placeholders. Ensure all components are responsive and mobile-first.
